key_observations: The strongest production progress was on the API-performance video: reference material was gathered and converted into a substantial written draft across two work blocks.
YouTube served two different roles today: technical references during the video work and unrelated entertainment in the evening.
Instagram also served two different roles: audience communication around midday and general browsing later.
A second Redis-related idea received some attention but remained exploratory, while the main video moved materially further toward production.
The channel dashboard was checked twice without a visible decision or content change tied to either check.
priority_alignment: The main video received the largest sustained creative effort and moved from research into drafting.
Community communication was handled without overtaking the main production thread.
The Redis idea remained secondary rather than displacing the more developed video.
important_uncertainty: The technical research appears connected to the planned video, but the raw events do not prove which references were ultimately retained in the draft.
The analytics checks are observable, but the timeline does not show the metrics or whether they informed any decision.
The Redis search and notes could be early production research or casual exploration; the evidence shows the idea remained unfinished.
Offline periods are outside desktop observation.
